Hi Markus / Laura,

I wanted to flag an exception request for Sofia Ivanova (Sr. SWE, Platform) ahead of her return from parental leave. Context and ask:

- Background: Sofia moved teams during the last calibration cycle (internal lateral transfer) and as a result missed the standard merit/equity window. Her scope has expanded (led infra reliability work, shipped two major Q3 features) and manager feedback is strong.
- Ask: approval to grant a 12% merit increase (off-cycle), a one-time spot bonus of $7,500, and an equity refresh exception to grant 2,000 RSUs (outside the quarterly window).
- Rationale bullets (short):
  - Peer comp benchmarking shows she is ~8% below market for level.
  - Recent promotions and scope expansion not captured in last cycle.
  - Want to avoid retention risk while she’s on leave.

Attachments: initial comp proposal (comp_proposal_sofia_2026-02-20.pdf) and current salary bands. I’ve included talent-ops to confirm process. Requesting an expedited review — Sofia’s return-to-work date is 2026-03-08 and we'd like approvals before then so changes can be applied to first payroll after return.

Thanks,
Hannah
